assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production 2D sprite sheet for the game レキシバトル. Reference image is style and character-identity reference ONLY: select ONLY the requested person and redraw them as a compact 2.5-head-tall chibi with thick dark outlines and simple flat cel colors matching the existing elementary-school game. Exactly FOUR equally wide square cells in ONE horizontal row, total image aspect 4:1. No cell outlines, no dividers, NO text, labels, numbers, watermark, scene, floor, cast shadow. Actual transparent background. Each cell has only ONE whole character. Cells 1,2,3 face STRICTLY SCREEN RIGHT with face, torso, toes all right; same camera angle, outfit, proportions, size. Each character's whole body and all props fully within its own cell with 10% padding. Feet in cells 1,2,3 aligned. Cell 1: standing ready. Cell 2: taking one walking step right, opposite leg forward. Cell 3: requested attack/skill pose, facing right. Cell 4: humorous defeated pose leaning or sitting backward, dazed eyes, head on left and feet on right; friendly, no violence or injury. Keep effects bounded, small, flat solid shapes. Never ghost images, extra arms, duplicated figures or giant aura. Preserve same head size between frames. No blood, monstrous faces, scary expression or demon features. The requested character is: Ishida Mitsunari, top row first: black armor, purple cords, small plain white banner with simple black square-and-circle crest (NO letters), folded purple war fan. Attack: thrust fan forward to command.
